svg.title: Deployment topology · memory layer and code graph
svg.desc: Two architectures pointing opposite ways on one machine: one daemon shared globally for the memory layer, one per repository for the code graph. The native backend admits a single process per database, and neither half gets around that.
svg.text: One machine, two architectures pointing opposite ways
